messages:
mina: noticing a surge of SCIM 409/422s against Okta groups since the midnight KMS rotate. Also seeing duplicate group members and missing audit actions. this smells like an externalId wrap/decrypt mismatch combined with a recent RBAC role rename we pushed yesterday.

charlie: can you drop a sample error?

mina: logs: 
```
2026-03-21T03:14:02Z ERROR scim.provisioner Worker(12): POST /Groups failed status=409 body={\"detail\":\"ExternalId decryption failed: key_version_mismatch\"}
2026-03-21T03:14:02Z WARN scim.audit Skipping audit write for group=eng-platform reason=missing_audit_token
```

priya: quick timeline - 22:30 we applied RBAC rename (role:platform-admin -> platform-infra), 23:40 we rolled envelope-proxy v2 (adds envelope.metadata.audit_token), 00:15 we rotated KMS key version. ordering might be off.

ops-bot: alert: scim.error.rate > 1% for okta-groups (00:00-03:00) — paging infra-oncall

infra-oncall: acknowledged. can we confirm whether encryptedExternalId includes both key_version and audit token in the envelope?

charlie: yes, new envelope schema v2 contains: {version, key_version, audit_token, alg}. older services emit v1 which lacked audit_token. if decrypt fails, we currently short-circuit and return 4xx instead of trying legacy parse.

mina: that explains missing audit writes — upstream drop happened during decrypt so we never extracted audit_token to replay audit events.

priya: mitigation plan: 1) enable compatibility parsing in scim-provisioner (try v2 then v1); 2) run one-off backfill to decrypt failed externalIds and emit audit events; 3) block any further KMS rotations until backfill done; 4) add health check that flags when scim.audit.skip_ratio > 0.2%.

infra-oncall: we can flip the compatibility flag in feature-flags now and rollback envelope-proxy if needed. doing toggle to accept v1+v2 in prod (safe rollout).

charlie: pushed branch scim/compat-decrypt -> will enable try-catch fallback. patch also logs envelope.metadata.* fields to internal-only audit stream for triage.

security-scan: note: make sure backfill job does not leak PII in logs — redact externalId value and only emit key_version + envelope_version + group_id.

mina: good call. scrubbed logging in the backfill code. job will run as a limited-perm service account.

priya: longer term: enforce deploy ordering in CI such that schema/proxy changes have a compatibility window overlapping KMS rotates and role renames. also add automated pre-rotate checks: ensure all consumers accept new envelope.version before rotating the key.

infra-oncall: creating incident INC-2026-118. blast radius: ~1.5k groups, ~4k users affected (temporary duplicates). SLA impact: group-sync errors > 5m threshold triggered.

charlie: one more item — audit store retention shows a gap around 23:45-00:30 where many audit tokens were not persisted. we need to run an audit reconciliation: correlate the backfilled decrypts with proxy deploy logs to reconstruct actor.

mina: I'll run the backfill now on staging and then a gradual rollout to prod during low traffic. will post progress here.

priya: alerts to add: (a) scim.decryption.failure.rate >= 0.5% over 5m, (b) scim.audit.missing_count >= 50 in 10m, (c) on deploy pipeline block when envelope.schema changes without compatibility flag.

ops-bot: runbook update suggested: when KMS rotate is planned, add a pre-check step: confirm "envelope_compatibility: true" across all scim consumers.

infra-oncall: agreed. locking KMS rotate schedule until backfill complete. will coordinate with security for approval.

mina: thanks team. running backfill now — staging shows 0 failures after compat patch. starting canary in prod with 5% of workers. will update thread. :white_check_mark:
